Companion Animal Travel Desk Intake and Escalation

This section sets the rules for handling companion animal travel inquiries, documentation, and issue escalation at Aurelia Skyways.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk serves passengers with calm, careful guidance from first contact through departure and arrival. Staff shall confirm travel details, record any animal care notes, and direct each case to the proper review path. For boarding, the required form is FM-597, and staff shall not begin the process until that document is complete and filed. When a passenger arrives for pickup and an issue requires higher review, arrival pickup uses EX-417 as the escalation extension for immediate routing to the supervisor. Employees shall speak clearly, protect privacy, and keep each exchange respectful, especially when a traveler is concerned about the animal's comfort or timing.

A welcome team prepares passengers for boarding with clear instructions, calm pacing, and patient support. Trained staff shall give every animal careful attention and shall check that carriers, labels, and documents match the reservation record. If a passenger reports distress or asks for extra help, the matter shall be handled with courtesy and without delay, and the supervisor shall listen carefully before deciding the next step. Staff shall document only verified details and shall avoid promising results that have not been approved through the regular review process.

For questions about procedure, exceptions, or escalations, contact the supervisor on duty at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
